PSA 99:1.KJV: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
PSA 99:1.BHSA: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָאָֽרֶץ׃

PSA 99:2.KJV: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
PSA 99:2.BHSA: יְ֭הוָה בְּצִיֹּ֣ון גָּדֹ֑ול וְרָ֥ם ה֝֗וּא עַל־כָּל־הָֽעַמִּֽים׃

PSA 99:3.KJV: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
PSA 99:3.BHSA: יֹוד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְךָ גָּדֹ֥ול וְנֹורָ֗א קָדֹ֥ושׁ הֽוּא׃

PSA 99:4.KJV: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
PSA 99:4.BHSA: וְעֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ מִשְׁפָּ֢ט אָ֫הֵ֥ב אַ֭תָּה כֹּונַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַעֲקֹ֤ב׀ אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃

PSA 99:5.KJV: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
PSA 99:5.BHSA: רֹֽומְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָדֹ֥ושׁ הֽוּא׃

PSA 99:6.KJV: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
PSA 99:6.BHSA: מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן׀ בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמֹ֑ו קֹרִ֥אים אֶל־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם׃

PSA 99:7.KJV: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
PSA 99:7.BHSA: בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן־לָֽמֹו׃

PSA 99:8.KJV: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
PSA 99:8.BHSA: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֢ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל־עֲלִילֹותָֽם׃

PSA 99:9.KJV: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.
PSA 99:9.BHSA: רֹֽומְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַ֣ר קָדְשֹׁ֑ו כִּֽי־קָ֝דֹ֗ושׁ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
